identity: The Moonfall Observatory charts the stars over a wood that someone is quietly emptying with marked snares.

quests.title: Sound Wood
quests.text: My sighting posts have split, which makes a fixed observation surprisingly adventurous. Bring me fifteen Wooden Planks of any wood for replacements. I can account for the movement of the stars once the posts stop contributing their own.

variants.text: My sighting posts have split, which makes a fixed observation surprisingly adventurous. Bring me fifteen Wooden Planks of any wood for replacements. I can account for the movement of the stars once the posts stop contributing their own.

The fish traps need lids that close properly; a fish should have to make some effort to escape. Bring me fifteen Wooden Planks of any wood. I will leave the fishers to fit them, since my last lid impressed everyone except the fish.

quests.lesson: A shared material errand: planks of any wood.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'Brauchbares Holz' (Lethen's sighting posts, Tokai's trap lids).

quests.title: A Pane Without a Crack
quests.text: The protective pane on my observing instrument has cracked across an otherwise promising view. Bring me six Glass, and I will do the fitting. I should like to discover something that is not a defect in my own equipment.
quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: A Fixed Point of Reference
quests.text: Forest signs keep acquiring new owners and new meanings; my observations need a point that stays put. Set up the prepared sighting frame at the {name:sighting_post} in the {name:deepwood}, then report to me. Its measurements are already marked, so you need not bring an opinion about the stars.
quests.completion: A firm frame gives me a reference I can use. Now I can check the observations without wondering which way the timber leaned.
quests.lesson: A use at a place or a day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: A Sound Way Up
quests.text: The observers' platform ladders have begun interrupting their ascent with ominous noises. Bring me ten Wooden Ladders to replace them. A discovery should bring an observer down to tell me about it, preferably by choice.
quests.lesson: A later errand or use; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: A Warden in Name Alone
quests.text: Poacher Snarewarden Bracken puts false forest signs over his trapping business and trades with Vetch and Rusk. Kill him in the {name:elderwood}, {dir_from_giver:snarewarden_bracken}, and bring me word. Calling himself a warden does not make the animals his to sell or our observing ground his to close.
quests.completion: Bracken's title has outlived its holder, and I shall retire it. We can take down his false signs and make the observing places useful again.
quests.lesson: The named leader; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: The Trade Beyond the Wood
quests.text: Bracken's dealings reach beyond Moonfall, and Faeris Rootbinder at Glassroot Gate needs to know what is being sold under a warden's name. Go and speak to her in Glassroot Wilds. A false sign can cause trouble well beyond the tree it is nailed to.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The departure id stays; free from 29, it requires nothing.
